lessons: Vicon C3D files frequently have units like mm/s^2 encoded in Latin-1, causing SWIG exceptions in ezc3d without string sanitization.
ezc3d requires analog frame counts to strictly match point_frames * (analog_rate / point_rate).
CLI flags with sub-arguments must be intercepted before parent argument parser with optional positional arguments.
